caption: The drawing depicts a single, large jug or pitcher rendered in grayscale pencil on a lightly toned background. The pitcher has an elongated, oval body that tapers to a narrow base set on a square platform. The upper rim of the pitcher undulates in a wave-like manner, creating an asymmetrical opening, and is accented by a fine beaded border. A gracefully curved handle extends from the upper section to the lower neck of the vessel. Shading is used to convey the volume and three-dimensionality of the object. In the lower right corner of the drawing, inside a small rectangle, there is a simplified line sketch of the pitcher showing its profile. The artist’s signature, "V. Caprano," is visible below the inset sketch. The image is framed by a lightly marked rectangular border.
title: Silver Creamer
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
